title: Whitened third moment bound
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\rho\in(-1,1)$, let $a=(a_i)_{i=1}^n$ be real coefficients, and choose a coordinate $i$. Under the correlated sign-pair distribution with keep probability $(1+\rho)/2$, the expected cube of the Euclidean norm of the vector obtained by applying the inverse square root of $\begin{pmatrix}1&\rho\\\rho&1\end{pmatrix}$ to $(a_i x_i,a_i y_i)$ is at most $\dfrac{4|a_i|^3}{\sqrt{1-\rho^2}}$.
hypotheses_covered: real coefficient function on Fin n
